description: Change the title, details, due date, due time or priority of one active task. Replaces the previous values of the fields you send; fields you omit are left alone, except that clearing the due date also clears its time. Confirm the change with the user first. Does not complete, reopen, archive or delete tasks.

description.description: New details, or null to clear.

anyOf.description: A calendar date as YYYY-MM-DD, or the word today or tomorrow. Words are resolved in the user's own time zone.

due_date.description: New due date (YYYY-MM-DD, today or tomorrow), or null to clear.

due_time.description: New due time HH:MM 24-hour, or null to clear.

name: update_task
title: Update task
